text:
maria: Quick question — can we add per-tenant cost caps that influence geo steering? e.g., prefer cheaper region if within 10% latency SLA.
aj: we talked about this in infra last week. Doable but need routing policy weight adjustments + header tag propagation.
kevin: Risk: cross-region data egress + per-tenant quota misattribution. We need route tags in headers for billing.
sophie: Console UX: allow rule "cost-aware fallback" with slider 0-100%? show estimated cost delta per model/region.
maria: example header we could use: X-Redwood-Route-Tag: tenant=acme;policy=cost_aware;prov=us-west
aj: For matching we can extend route rules: match: method=POST path=/v1/generate header:X-Redwood-Route-Tag contains policy=cost_aware -> prefer region us-west unless latency>200ms
kevin: telemetry needs new metric: routing.decisions{tenant,policy,from_region,to_region,reason} increment
maria: also need fallback to Local->Nearby->LowCost tiers. fallback order should be policy-configurable.
sophie: UX question: when a tenant sets a budget, do we throttle, switch model (quantized), or route to cheaper region? Need UI options + presets.
aj: Implementation sketch:
- add policy type "cost_favor" to routing engine
- compute score = latency_sla_penalty*latency_score + cost_weight*normalized_cost
- choose region with min score
kevin: make sure quota accounting happens in the origin region for audit. Tag requests with original_region header: X-Redwood-Origin-Region
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 22:30 UTC for cost-aware routing feature flag A/B
maria: can we add a dry-run mode that logs decisions without routing change? Please add console toggle.
aj: yes — dry-run and reason field in telemetry, plus sample logs.
sophie: mockup: show map with heatmap of "potential savings" per tenant and toggle to preview route changes. small "apply" step with canary %.
maria: curl test snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Route-Tag: tenant=acme;policy=cost_aware" -d '{"model":"gpt-4x","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
aj: also think about header sanitization for forwarded requests (strip user-supplied X-Redwood-* unless authenticated)
kevin: agree. threat model: tenant can fake tags to get cheaper routing. must authenticate tag issuer (console, signed token).
sophie: note for product: teach customers about provenance and egress implications in docs.
maria: ok I'll draft a short RFC and a console mock. Assigning follow-ups: aj (runtime), kevin (telemetry & billing), sophie (UX + docs). I'll drop doc link here when ready.
aj: ack
kevin: ack
sophie: ack
maria: thanks :thumbsup:
